title: Ancient Egypt
info: Ancient Egypt was a civilization along the Nile River more than 5,000 years ago.
Egyptians built pyramids as tombs for pharaohs. They wrote using hieroglyphs.
The Nile River provided water, food, and transportation, making life possible in the desert.
Pharaohs were rulers who were thought to be like gods. Famous ones include Tutankhamun and Cleopatra.
